newsitem.title: GERMANY: German economic recovery only partly under way - Ifo.
newsitem.headline: German economic recovery only partly under way - Ifo.

text.p: German economic recovery is only partly under way, according to a survey released on Sunday by the German economic research institute Ifo.
West German business confidence and prospects for future business improved in October, the Ifo report said, while belief that the economy was making improvements grew strongly.
But in east Germany the recovery pattern was not establishing itself properly. The overall situation was described only as satisfactory in the report.
The business environment in west Germany had clearly improved, the Ifo survey said, with lively demand leading to an increase in the production of finished goods, and an improvement in orders.
Export development was at a level last seen in August, while production plans expanded further.

In the east German sector, optimism and pessimism balanced each other out. Demand was lower and job losses continued to grow, with unemployment expected to grow by one or two percent in coming months.

The poor situation for the west German construction industry had hardly changed, although those surveyed were slightly less pessimistic for the next six months, despite an expected fall-off in production.
The outlook for the east German construction sector was also pessimistic, with further job losses expected.
The wholesale sector in west Germany saw very little improvement in October, but it did expect turnover this year to match that of last year, even though orders fell.
The east German wholesale sector clearly fell in the period and it looked like there could be more job losses there.
